title: Harissa Lime Leaf Stir Fry
description: A spicy and flavorful stir fry made with harissa, lime, and leafy greens, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Chopped leafy greens (such as kale or spinach)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they start to caramelize, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped leafy greens and cook until they are wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the harissa and lime juice, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
